slides.title: Analysts warn of an Ethiopia-Sudan proxy war
Protect civilians. Peaceful dialogue.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

card.title: “All the ingredients are present for an intensifying proxy war”
card.body: Alan Boswell, International Crisis Group, on Ethiopia and Sudan. Each government accuses the other of backing armed groups; both deny it. AP could not verify either side's claims.
